oldLevel.label: Spectre level as before 3.19
oldLevel.description: Gem level 20 makes level 76 spectres (now 70), gem level 25 makes 83 (now 78).

extraLevels.label: Extra spectre levels
extraLevels.description: Added to the spectre level after that.

moreDamage.label: Spectres deal more damage
moreDamage.description: A "more" multiplier on top of everything else.

anyCorpse.label: Any monster can be a spectre
anyCorpse.description: Every corpse can be raised, including monsters GGG made un-raisable.

uniques.label: Unique monsters too
uniques.description: Unique monsters and bosses can be raised. A few bosses may not act right as spectres.

bosses.label: Map and pinnacle bosses too
bosses.description: Off: unique monsters can be raised, but not map, Atlas or pinnacle bosses.

commandIgnoresSpellEcho.label: /spectre raises one spectre
commandIgnoresSpellEcho.description: The /spectre command's cast does not repeat with Spell Echo (which would raise a second corpse). Your own Raise Spectre casts are unchanged.

oldScaling.label: Minion damage and life as before 3.19
oldScaling.description: 3.19 cut the damage and life of minions (not spectres) by about 20% at gem level 20. This gives it back.

moreDamage.label: More minion damage
moreDamage.description: 25% more makes up for 20% less. Animate Guardian, Animate Weapon, Blink Arrow and Mirror Arrow are left out: 3.19 did not change their damage.

oldMinionDamage.label: Minion Damage Support as before 3.15
oldMinionDamage.description: 25% to 49% more damage at gem levels 1 to 20 (now 25% to 39%).

noLifePenalty.label: No "25% less maximum life" on Minion Damage Supports
noLifePenalty.description: 3.15 added it (the Awakened one has it too).

minionKillsAreYours.label: Minion kills count as your kills too
minionKillsAreYours.description: A kill by your minion (or your totem, trap or mine) also counts as yours: your on-kill effects, charges on kill and other "when you kill" bonuses happen for it. It still counts as the minion's kill.
